Malicious Supply-Chain Indicators

No confirmed malicious supply-chain indicators.

Automatic Execution Paths

  • pyproject.toml uses the poetry.core.masonry.api build backend. No setup.py, .pth, sitecustomize.py, usercustomize.py, or install-time execution hook evidence was found.
  • tool.poetry.scripts defines defense_predictor and defense_predictor_download console scripts, but these are normal CLI entry points that require explicit user execution.
  • defense_predictor/__init__.py imports core and downloads, but the provided code does not show import-time downloading, network transmission, file harvesting, or other malicious automatic behavior.

Theft / Exfiltration / Persistence / Lateral Movement / Stealth

  • Credential harvesting: No broad discovery of environment variables, .env files, SSH keys, cloud credentials, CI/CD tokens, wallet files, or similar secrets was found.
  • Staging/exfiltration: No evidence of archive staging, base64 packaging of harvested files, external upload, or webhook exfiltration was found.
  • Network: downloads.py appears to provide a user-invoked defense_predictor_download command for downloading public model weights from Zenodo and Facebook ESM public URLs. No attacker C2 or suspicious upload endpoint evidence was found.
  • Persistence: No cron, systemd, launch agent, shell profile modification, background polling loop, or similar persistence mechanism was found.
  • Lateral movement: No Kubernetes, Docker socket, cloud metadata, GitHub Actions, or package registry token access was found.
  • Obfuscation/loader: No evidence of eval, exec, marshal/zlib loaders, obfuscated downloader stubs, or self-deleting droppers was found.

Distribution Integrity Anomalies

  • The extracted sdist appears to contain a small set of Python source files, README, and pyproject.toml; no unexplained native binaries or hidden payloads were identified.
  • Dependencies broadly match the stated ML/bioinformatics purpose; no direct evidence of a suspicious dependency insertion was found in the provided material.
  • No direct evidence of typosquatting or dependency confusion was identified.
  • Wheel-vs-sdist mismatch could not be assessed from the provided input.

Additional Verification Needed

  • This review is limited to the provided extracted sdist text. If a wheel exists for the same version, it should be compared against the sdist.
  • The .pkl and .pt model files downloaded by defense_predictor_download are not included in the package artifact and were not inspected. Because joblib.load()/pickle-style loading can execute code if the file is malicious, the external model files should be verified for hash, provenance, and contents.
